title: The only tests of the escalation path assert dry-run constants, so no escalation failure can fail them
method: mutation testing: three independent mutants of cura/comms/voice.py replayed against tests/test_voice.py in a hermetic copy
triggers: crisis_alert dials profile.phone instead of contact['phone']
observed_at_discovery: CuraVoice(dry_run=True).call() returns answered=True, call_sid='dry_run' unconditionally and send_sms() returns delivered=True unconditionally; every assertion in TestDryRunCalls reads one of those constants and none reads to_number. Observed: with alert_caregiver's caregiver_phone forced to '', 157 passed. With crisis_alert dialling the elder's own number instead of each emergency contact, 157 passed. With the medication block deleted from morning_checkin, 157 passed (test_morning_checkin's disjunction is satisfied by the constant line 'Press 1 if you've taken your medications', which always contains 'medication'). With alert_caregiver's SMS never sent, 157 passed. Repro exit 1, 1 failed 1 passed.
